sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES ('hello')
note: minimal INSERT with single column and single row

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('a', 1)
note: INSERT specifying two columns

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty, flag) VALUES ('b', 2, true)
note: INSERT with three columns including boolean

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, val, qty) VALUES ('c', 9.99, 5)
note: INSERT with numeric value

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('r1', 1), ('r2', 2), ('r3', 3)
note: multi-row VALUES list

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('r1', 1), ('r2', 2), ('r3', 3), ('r4', 4), ('r5', 5)
note: multi-row VALUES list with five rows

sql: INSERT INTO s.t2 DEFAULT VALUES
note: DEFAULT VALUES form inserts all defaults (s.t2 has defaults for all NOT NULL cols)

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('d', DEFAULT)
note: DEFAULT keyword inside VALUES list for individual column

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, flag, qty) VALUES ('e', DEFAULT, DEFAULT)
note: multiple DEFAULT keywords in one row

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, status) VALUES ('f', DEFAULT)
note: DEFAULT for enum column with defined default

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) SELECT label FROM s.t2 WHERE label IS NOT NULL
note: INSERT ... SELECT from another table

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) SELECT name, qty FROM s.t WHERE qty > 0
note: INSERT ... SELECT self-referencing same table

sql: INSERT INTO s.t2 (t_id, label) SELECT id, name FROM s.t
note: INSERT ... SELECT cross-table

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) SELECT 'from_values'
note: INSERT ... SELECT with literal constant

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) SELECT name, qty FROM s.t UNION ALL SELECT name, qty FROM s.t
note: INSERT ... SELECT with UNION ALL

sql: WITH src AS (SELECT 'cte_row' AS n, 42 AS q) INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) SELECT n, q FROM src
note: INSERT with leading CTE (WITH ... INSERT)

sql: WITH src AS (SELECT name FROM s.t WHERE qty > 0), src2 AS (SELECT label FROM s.t2 WHERE label IS NOT NULL) INSERT INTO s.t (name) SELECT name FROM src UNION ALL SELECT label FROM src2
note: INSERT with multiple CTEs

sql: WITH moved AS (SELECT id, name FROM s.t WHERE qty = 0) INSERT INTO s.t2 (label) SELECT name FROM moved
note: INSERT consuming data-reading CTE

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES ('ret') RETURNING id
note: INSERT ... RETURNING single column

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('ret2', 7) RETURNING *
note: INSERT ... RETURNING * (all columns)

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('ret3', 8) RETURNING id, name, qty
note: INSERT ... RETURNING explicit column list

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('ret4', 9) RETURNING id AS inserted_id, name AS inserted_name
note: INSERT ... RETURNING with column aliases

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('ret5', 10) RETURNING qty * 2 AS doubled
note: INSERT ... RETURNING computed expression

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES ('dup1') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
note: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING without specifying conflict target

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name) VALUES (1, 'dup2') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
note: ON CONFLICT (column) DO NOTHING

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name) VALUES (1, 'dup3') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
note: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET using EXCLUDED

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name, qty) VALUES (1, 'dup4', 99) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, qty = EXCLUDED.qty
note: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET multiple columns

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name, qty) VALUES (1, 'dup5', 5) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET qty = s.t.qty + EXCLUDED.qty
note: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE referencing both target table and EXCLUDED

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name, qty) VALUES (1, 'dup6', 0) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name WHERE s.t.qty < 10
note: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET ... WHERE condition

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name) VALUES (1, 'dup7') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name RETURNING id, name
note: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE with RETURNING

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name, qty) VALUES (1, 'dup8', 1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
note: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING with RETURNING

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name) VALUES (1, 'cn') ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT t_pkey DO NOTHING
note: ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT name DO NOTHING

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name) VALUES (1, 'cn2') ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT t_pkey DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
note: ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT name DO UPDATE

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, tags) VALUES ('tagged', ARRAY['a','b','c'])
note: INSERT with array literal value

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, data) VALUES ('json_row', '{"key": "value"}'::jsonb)
note: INSERT with jsonb cast value

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, home) VALUES ('addr_row', ROW('123 Main', 'Springfield', '62701')::s.addr)
note: INSERT with composite type ROW constructor cast

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, status) VALUES ('mood_row', 'happy'::s.mood)
note: INSERT with enum cast value

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, span) VALUES ('range_row', '[1,10)'::int4range)
note: INSERT with range type value

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, created_at) VALUES ('ts_row', '2024-06-01 12:00:00+00'::timestamptz)
note: INSERT with explicit timestamptz value

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES ('q1'); INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES ('q2')
note: two separate INSERT statements in one case

sql: INSERT INTO s.t2 (label, amount) VALUES ('x', 1.50)
note: INSERT into s.t2 with numeric amount

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('neg', -5)
note: INSERT with negative integer value

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, val) VALUES ('null_val', NULL)
note: INSERT with explicit NULL value in nullable column

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES (E'escape\nnewline')
note: INSERT with E-escape string literal

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES (U&'uni\0063ode')
note: INSERT with Unicode escape string literal

sql: INSERT INTO s.t AS t_alias (name) VALUES ('aliased')
note: INSERT INTO table AS alias - table alias for use in ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE

sql: INSERT INTO s.t AS alias (id, name) VALUES (1, 'aliased2') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = alias.name
note: INSERT table alias used in ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE to reference target row

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) SELECT name, qty FROM s.t ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
note: INSERT ... SELECT with ORDER BY and LIMIT

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) SELECT name FROM s.t WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM s.t2)
note: INSERT ... SELECT with subquery in WHERE

sql: INSERT INTO s.events (occurred, payload) VALUES ('2024-03-15', '{}'::jsonb)
note: INSERT into partitioned table routed to correct partition

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name) OVERRIDING USER VALUE VALUES (999, 'override_user')
note: OVERRIDING USER VALUE for identity column

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (id, name) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (998, 'override_sys')
note: OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE forces supplied value for identity column

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('w1', 1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET qty = EXCLUDED.qty WHERE EXCLUDED.qty > 0 RETURNING id, qty
note: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE WHERE + RETURNING combined

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES ($$it's a dollar-quoted name$$)
note: INSERT with dollar-quoted string literal

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES ($tag$tagged value$tag$)
note: INSERT with tagged dollar-quote string

sql: INSERT s.t (name) VALUES ('no_into')
note: syntax error: missing INTO keyword

sql: INSERT INTO s.t VALUES ('wrong_col_count', 999, 'extra')
note: error: too many values for columns when no column list given and types mismatch

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ('mismatch')
note: error: column count mismatch - 2 columns but 1 value

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name, qty) VALUES ()
note: syntax error: empty VALUES row

sql: INSERT INTO s.t (name) VALUES ('bad_conflict') ON CONFLICT (id) DO INSERT INTO s.t VALUES ('x')
note: syntax error: invalid ON CONFLICT action (not DO NOTHING or DO UPDATE)
